debrief db-021
1) the actor r-e-v-i-e-w-e-d the c-l-o-s-e-d e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s to c-o-n-f-i-r-m the a-c-t-i-o-n s e q u e n c e was c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e-d and l-e-f-t a n o t e d l-o-g a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t on f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the s-o-u-r-c-e a-t-t-r-i-b-u-t-i-o-n v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) the actor e-x-a-m-i-n-e-d the f-i-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s as a h-i-s-t-o-r-i-c-a l r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e and r-e-c-o-g-n-i-z-e-d the p-l-a-n n-i-n-g c-o-n-t-e-n-t as d-e-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t a n a-l-y-s-i-s m-e-m-o in the w-o-r-k-s-p-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-a-t-a v-a-l-i-d-i-t-y a-u-d-i-t
3) the actor f-o-r-m-a-t-t-e-d the a-f-t-e-r a-c-t-i-o-n n-o-t-e-s in p-a-s-t t-e-n-s-e t-h-i-r-d p-e-r-s-o-n p-r-o-s-p-e-c-t to m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y and l-e-f-t a s-t-y-l-e-c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-t d-r-a-f-t for r-e-v-i-e-w while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-i-d-e-n-t-i-a-l i-t-y c-l-a-s-s-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-h-e-c-k
4) the actor c-o-p-i-e-d the m-a-t-e-r-i-a-l s p-e-c-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n-s from the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e d-e-s-c-r-i-p-t-i-o-n to e-n-s-u-r-e a-c-c-u-r-a-c-y in the d-e-b-r-i-e-f and l-e-f-t a n a-c-c-u-r-a-t-e s-u-m-m-a-r-y r-e-c-o-r-d for f-u-t-u-r-e r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
5) the actor a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r f-i-l-e-s with the a-p-p-r-o-p-r-i-a-t-e t-a-g-s and l-e-f-t a c-l-e-a-n a-r-c-h-i-v-e e-n-t-r-y p-o-i-n-t in the s-y-s-t-e-m while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w a-n-d a-p-p-r-o-v-a-l p-r-o-c-e-s-s
